svg.title: Right foot, dorsal view: tarsals, metatarsals, phalanges
svg.desc: Right foot from above, toes up, big toe (hallux) at the viewer's left. The talus sits above the calcaneus; navicular is medial, cuboid lateral, and the three cuneiforms lie under metatarsals 1-3. The big toe has 2 phalanges; the other toes have 3. "Hallux" is shown as the first-toe phalanges; it is not a separate structure.
